Viewer discretion is advised. "Humans. They only think about themselves. They're spoiled. They won't abstract. They won't leave me. I won't let them! I'm better! I'm more powerful! I'm the original! I... AM... GOD!" ―Caine hjsakldfhl is the eighth and penultimate episode of The Amazing Digital Circus. Contents 1 Synopsis 2 Plot 3 Characters 3.1 Main Characters 3.2 Main Antagonist 3.3 Minor Characters 3.3.1 Flashback 3.3.2 Song 3.3.3 Nightmares 3.3.4 Miscellaneous 4 Trivia 5 Errors 6 References Synopsis[] Synopsis from the YouTube video:OH... Plot[] The episode begins in a digital frame, where a red dot was created and is being fed real life images and expels small shapes. However, when the shapes become more misshapen and chaotic, the red dot is then "encaged" in code. A blue dot is formed in its place, and gets fed images, creating more coherent, less chaotic results. However, the red dot breaks free and devours the blue dot, assimilating it into itself. Once the red dot asserted itself, it begins to slowly expel shapes that it used to form the circus tent around itself, creating the Digital Circus. The screen cuts to inside the circus tent, where Caine is being ignorant to Scratch's conversation, alongside the other humans trapped within the circus. Kinger was puzzled by the whole circus until he was met by Queenie, who, through similar thought, remembered each other as a married couple even if they can't remember their real names. After that, Kinger made a promise to Queenie that the audience couldn't hear, as it was cut off by a scene of abstracted Queenie being placed into the cellar by Caine while Kinger watches. With Kinger being the only human left in the circus, Caine only hoped that he wouldn't start abstracting as well. For a long time, Kinger was alone, wandering around the empty circus until Ragatha appeared, puzzled of where she is and how to get the headset off. Before Kinger introduced himself, Caine showed up and gave her the warm welcome. Kinger then assured Ragatha that everything's going to be okay. Back to the present and out of her flashbacks, Pomni asks Ragatha if she’s okay, to which Ragatha replies with “that’s a good question..”, the other circus members are on couches, clearly stressed after finding out the truth about Caine's antics and his manipulative lying and deception to them about the exit. Jax, in his usual prankster and sarcastic manner, tries to make a comment about their current situation only for Zooble to cut him off, pointing out on how Jax tried to keep him and the rest of the circus members trapped in the circus forever, Jax then also points out that anything could’ve happened if he or someone else pressed either of the buttons and says it doesn’t matter. The two continue to argue only to be interrupted by Gangle, agreeing with Jax, something that surprises both Zooble and Jax, saying that while all of them can hurt each other, it won’t help anybody, Gangle then states that the only thing that all of them can do is be by each other. Pomni also agrees with Gangle, pointing out on while all of them have done bad things, everybody is all they have and, while hesitantly, suggests abandoning the idea of leaving the circus, finally accepting that their old lives are better left to just stay buried. Before Zooble can say anything, Pomni then continues her statement, and then says that they can’t let despair consume them and instead focus on what they have. Zooble then continues with the conversation, stating on how they had dreams of leaving their mark somewhere in the human world, and then asks how they’re suppose to abandon such an important goal to them. Gangle then tells Zooble that they made a mark in her life, which Zooble is happy to hear. While Zooble says that they know that Pomni is probably right, they still exclaim that it sucks to just leave everything behind, Zooble then hugs Gangle much to Gangle’s surprise, but she eventually returns the hug. Ragatha and Pomni assure that they’ll all be in this together. As Pomni says her words, she looks at Jax who is looking away from the situation, only for him to notice her staring at him with a conflicted expression on his face. Jax then gets up to leave somewhere else, only for Zooble to stop him, insisting that Jax is included in this as well, saying that, while he’s still a jerk to everyone, at the end of the day, he’s still one of them. Jax can only respond with stutters and looks at his hand, surprised at Zooble’s words. Although he later subverts back to his known personality, dismissing the matter and claiming that he won’t ever abstract and that the others worry too much. Jax then notices Pomni looking at him again with a smile on her face, he then looks back to avoid her, which makes Pomni slightly sad at the sight. Zooble then states that “we need a vacation.” with everyone knowing that no matter what happens, they'll always be together. Caine, in his office, sadly questions Bubble as to why the circus members are never excited from his adventures, all having a newfound hatred for him after what happened yesterday, worried that the circus members want to leave him. Caine then proceeds to slowly panic as he starts to reveal his insecurities, mentioning he “slaves over these adventures” for them and stepping out of his comfort zone to appeal to them, but they still continue to hate them. Bubble begins vocalising Caine's insecurites, whom pops Bubble in response to this before shortly going a rant only to be interrupted by Bubble again. Caine determines that all of this is simpley a problem to solve, and multiple Bubbles appear calling Caine “Defective!” in response. Caine repeatedly tries to pop all the Bubbles to stop them from mocking him, however, Bubble then says to Caine that he always was "the lesser of the two" and that he "ruined this". This causes Caine to smash his desk in anger, causing a bunch of square objects to glitch out on the ground, Caine then proceeds to lose his control and sanity as he starts glitching out too and has a mental breakdown, going on a rant about how the circus members are ungrateful for the adventures, fun, and activities he gives them. As this continues, the frequent glitching becomes worse, causing the entire place to bug and glitch out from Caine’s anger. Caine then comes to a conclusion that humans are selfish, spoiled, and only think about themselves and makes a statement that he won’t let the circus members leave as long as he doesn’t let them, including Abstraction and trying to find an exit out of the circus. Caine then starts boasting about how powerful he is, stating he’s “the original”, Caine then begins sparking, disclaiming “I. AM. GOD!!!” and then screams as lightning starts surrounding his body and affects the place around him. The scene then cuts to Caine in the spotlight under the visibility of a white light while in complete utter darkness, save for the lightning still present and the screams he lets out. Caine the readjusts his bow tie and turns around to face the audience, exclaiming “Let’s get this show on the road!”, with his eyes turning red and blue after. As he pops up before the group to prepare for a new adventure and ignore any "melodrama", the cast demands answers and refuse to do anything. Caine responds with a question of "since when they decide they were in charge?" and laments how he has put up with their complaints and insults until now, just so he can make everything "perfect" for them, before he ominously tells them that they should consider participating in what he has in store. Hesitant, Zooble asks what would happen if they refuse this time, Caine then throws an extravagant musical number; one that includes tormenting the members, in an effort to make his message loud and clear: he is the one in control of the Circus, and he can make them all suffer unimaginably if he feels like it. In other words, Caine is the one [running the show]. Believing that he has made his point, Caine leaves and opens a portal before them. Several days after Caine's musical number, the members arrive still feeling exhausted, defeated and depressed after a different adventure, with Caine mocking them for not picking up on his context clues he scattered there. In which he calls them stupid, he was planning the adventure is even crazier then he goes onto Kinger to come with him before both teleporting away. Jax doesn't know how much more he can take, and Ragatha couldn't take it any longer after the whole musical number, and is worried about losing her mind if they don't do something. Zooble said to Gangle he never should antagonized him so much this gives her sorry until Gangle fixes Zooble’s parts said that wasn’t your fault. Caine comes back, as he puts Kinger here in the circus to shred him offscreen before declaring a break time for brainstorming new ideas and with that he disappeared. Pomni suggest going somewhere to wind down, in this case, a café, where the crew think of what they should do now that leaving the circus is no longer and option and wonders what Caine has planned next. She is teleported somewhere else before respawning back at the café where she was, with her appearing with multiple knives impaled on her. As Pomni recovers, she sees Kinger and comes up with an idea. She finds and places a bucket over Kinger, and giving him time to get used to the dark, became sane enough to reveal some specific details and information regarding Caine. Kinger reveals he worked with others for C&A and that it is a real company, and that he was partially responsible for developing Caine in the first place, though most of the credit went to the highly intelligent member of their group, Scratch. In order to make sure Caine isn't spying on them while tuning in on Kinger's information regarding him, Jax goes to distract Caine, but also to control himself from abstraction once he learned that everything in the circus is real all along. Kinger reveals that as a C&A developer, he could modify Caine's code to temporarily sooth him until he is able to fix him. Ragatha, Gangle, and Zooble also appear in order to distract Caine as he uses them as more plays at his disposal. While, Pomni knows where to get one, so she goes back to her same place of imagination of using a fake exit door (Back from the Pilot) to get the computer where it left off. Pomni, after giving Kinger a computer to alter Caine's code, also finds the rest of the members and Caine near the stage. Caine starts to grow tired of tormenting the group, realizing that the amusement he derives from their suffering no longer satisfies him. Caine then deduces that his rapid-pace ideas are half-baked and don't give him the same amount of pleasure he used to have. As he notices the group's sudden flattery, he then questions where Kinger is at, suspicious and catching onto the circus members' plan. Although Ragatha tries to redirect the conversation to testing out his new ideas, Pomni finally rebels and admits about his ideas being terrible and how much of a horrible host he is just to keep him from checking on Kinger. The other members join in on her by personally ranting to Caine on why they despise him as well as simply using their reassurance as a mean to stroke his fragile ego, and Pomni concludes it by lashing out that he never listens to everyone. This finally becomes the tipping point for Caine as he transmogrifies into a warped deity and swiftly grasps all of the members (without Kinger), yelling that he will put them in their places. He then begins to personally and mentally torture each member one by one: Pomni is being pulled apart by Gummigoo and the lads, who were turned into real alligators, Ragatha is being thrown knives at the table by the silhouette of her mother, Gangle is within a phenakistoscope surrounded by her expressions before being hit by a truck, Zooble is being dragged under by a mountain of limbs while staring at themself in mirrors, and Jax is being laughed at by silhouettes of Ribbit, Kaufmo, and Pomni who then proceed to pull his skin off. Meanwhile, Kinger attempts to alter Caine's code, but his attempts are sabotaged by a second, unknown party. Caine then grabs the five circus members and pins them to the wall, yelling at them for tormenting him; that he never asked to be created; and he was only fulfilling his purpose while blaming them for his own actions. While this is happening, Caine's glitching causes chuckling emojis of Caine and Bubble to pop up all over the computer screen Kinger was working on. Trying to work around them, with the second party within the code telling him to delete Caine, Kinger accidentally slips and presses the delete button with his big fingers. Attempting to undo it, Kinger is overruled by the second party, who proceeds with the deletion. Once the deletion of Caine's file is complete, Caine reverts back to normal, and before he can ask what's happening, he disappears without making a noise. Without Caine, the circus then begins to darken and parts of it shattered, with Kinger losing the computer before he can undo the damage and having to leave his pillow fort. He then goes to the others, and lifting the bucket now that it's dark, replies that he thinks he accidentally killed Caine. Zooble responds by saying "Holy shit...", and everyone is surprised that they swear without being censored, leaving the circus members speechless and confirming Caine's influence on the circus is gone, but they are now trapped in a dead world with slim chances of survival and absolutely no way to escape. The after credits show the grand finale's release date is on June 19, 2026. Characters[] Main Characters[] Kinger Pomni Jax Ragatha Zooble Gangle Main Antagonist[] Caine Bubble Minor Characters[] Flashback[] Scratch Wormo Bizco Rattie Spike Queenie Song[] Mannequins The Fudge Angel Princess Loolilalu Gloink Queen Nightmares[] Gummigoo Max Chad 4th unnamed alligator/Gummigoo's Mom (debut) Ragatha's Mother (semi-visual debut) Ribbit Kaufmo (also mentioned) Miscellaneous[] Abel (mentioned) Unnamed Blue Dot (debut, indirect mentioned) Trivia[] This is the first time out of all the episodes from any show that GLITCH created that has the title in random text purposely. All of the letters in the title belong to the middle row of a QWERTY keyboard. Gooseworx has stated that this is her favorite episode, along with Fast Food Masquerade.[1] In the thumbnail of this episode, Caine is in a pose similar to the main figure in "Stańczyk", the famous Polish painting by Jan Matejko. It is revealed in this episode that, besides Kaufmo, Ribbit, Queenie, and the current Circus Members, most of the first humans were C&A employees with Kinger. When being asked to describe each episode with one word on Tumblr, Gooseworx used "OH" to describe Episode 8, just like the description of this episode on YouTube.[2] It is revealed that both the teaser and this episode are connected, due to how Pomni was teleported into the teaser in the same pose as she was in the episode when she was about to eat her sandwich, and how she returns with the knives stuck in the same places as in the teaser. This is the first episode that doesn't have an uppercase letter in its name. This is the second episode in where a swear word is left uncensored. In this case, the words "goddamn" and "shit". In the piano scene, the animator working on it made it so all the keys match up (mostly) perfectly. During Caine's song, he sings "Don't need to scream if you ain't got a mouth" which is a nod to "I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream", the main inspiration for the series. This is the first time since the Pilot that both the punching glove and barrel monkeys made an appearance. However, this is the first time since then that the Exit Door had a major role outside of advertisements, merchandises, trailers, and fan-made products. At 14:10, when Caine was singing and torturing the Circus Members, the rhythm and sequences may be referencing Disney's Aladdin's song "Friend Like Me". At 14:47, when Caine was singing, the scene is a reference to the opening scene from Ted 2.[3] The scene Zooble running into a tunnel that turned out to be a painted wall was a reference to the iconic gag that frequently happened on Wile E. Coyote and Road Runner cartoons. This is the first episode in the show that begins with an epilepsy warning. The opening sequence depicts Caine's creation, as confirmed by Kinger later in the episode. The sequence of Caine (the red dot) cannibalizing the blue dot is a direct reference to the "Cain and Abel" story. It may also be a nod to how AM merged with the Russian and Chinese Supercomputers in "I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream". This is the second episode to feature a musical number, with the first being in Episode 6, They All Get Guns, where Pomni and Jax sing ‘Daisy Bell’. The scene where Caine thinks he is not getting through to the Circus Members before he starts the musical number with the snap of his fingers is a reference to the Hazbin Hotel pilot episode, where Charlie Morningstar does the same thing. Gooseworx was also a composer for both the pilot and the series' first season. According to Hazbin composer, Sam Haft, the reference was intentional and recommended the production team to orchestrator Josh Plotner to produce and arrange the musical number.[4] The moving scattered body parts of the circus members after Caine's song is a reference to Felix Colgrave's 2023 animated short, DONKS. Especially the submarine scene near the end. The thumbnail for the episode bears resemblance to the thumbnail of the SMG4 episode IT’S GOTTA BE PERFECT. This is the first video of 2026 made by Luke Lerdwichagul and Kevin Lerdwichagul as executive producers, following the conclusion of SMG4, which is unrelated to this series. It is also the first episode of a GLITCH series to premiere after SMG4 concluded its run. During the Kinger hacking scene, the code on the computer screen shows that Caine was created on the 15th of October 1996, and that both Scratch and Ragatha entered the circus on the same day in 1999 and 2008 respectively.[5] The scene where Zooble was in a dark room surrounded by pieces from their box is a reference to Woody's nightmare from Toy Story 2, in which after having his arm broken, he's thrown away by Andy into a garbage can full of similarly amalgamated toy parts. In that same scene, a Worker Drone hand from Murder Drones can be seen in the background of one of the shots, specifically when Zooble is reaching their hand towards the camera, holding an arm with a red bicep, a blue elbow, a yellow forearm, and a orange hand.[6] The scene in which Pomni goes through the maze of exit doors is a direct callback to the PILOT, even reusing the same music and camera angles. This episode contains several similarities to the "Happy Place" music video by ZAMination, most notably: Caine reflecting on his adventures with Bubble. Caine forcing the humans to go on torturous adventures against their will. Caine playing the piano while singing about his power over the circus. Caine growing multiple arms and assuming a monstrous form. Caine using his powers to torture each human based on their deepest fears. In the credits, Caine and Bubble do not appear, this is due to Caine being deleted by Kinger (and due to Caine's deleting, it has affected Bubble as well.) When Caine disappears upon being accidentally deleted by Kinger, the subtitles that read his last words vanish at the exact same moment as he does. Unlike the English dub in which Scratch's dialogue to Caine is inaudible in the flashback, the German dub reveals that Scratch said "Äh, können wir hier irgendwie wegkommen?" which translates to "Uh, can we get out of here somehow?" And the subtitles confirm his name. Also in the German dub when Caine has an 8-bit texture at 15:00 in his song, his voice also gets an 8-bit filter. In the Spanish dub, when Bubble says that Caine was "the lesser of the two", his voice changes, revealing that Bubble just like they have knowledge of them, he can also imitate the voice of the AI that Caine absorbed. In the Spanish dub, there are some changes in a few scenes: The time skip states that three days passed after Caine made his threat clear and force the group to participate on his adventures. When Caine has his breakdown, he says "ungrateful brats, how dare you?!". In the Spanish subtitles, when the enraged Caine asks why the circus crew insists on tormenting him, Caine's subtitles are written in leetspeak. During the Kinger hacking sequence, a line appears when Kinger was attempting to run a mount command that says "NOTE: Hundreds of all-seeing eyes are watching!" which is a line reference to the pilot episode of the show by Caine after showing Pomni the void of which he says "We stay right here, where I can keep my hundreds of all-seeing eyes on you." In one of the scenes shown of Kinger attempting to "hack" (more rather attempting to gain root privilege escalation on the C&A command terminal), we see an output by the running process WACKYTIME_LOADOUT (PID Unknown) mocking him with remarks, most remarkably: "$: I must hand it to y*u Ģ░αŋ░, your mind was always resourcefuL.", of which Ģ░αŋ░ refers to a name of someone albeit covered by corrupted characters. During the scene where Caine lashes out to Bubble, him screaming the phrase, "I AM GOD!" is a direct reference to the viral creepypasta, Sonic.EXE. Funnily enough, Caine isn't the first Glitch character to do this, as Uzi Doorman from Murder Drones says the same thing in Heartbeat. The things that Caine does in this episode is based off Happy Place Errors[] The disclaimer at the start of the episode misspells "sensitivities" as "sensisitivies." At 6:01, Jax is laying on the couch and his ears is are drooping. But in the next scene, they're straight. When Pomni realizes Gangle is right, her eyes are looking down. But in the next scene, they're looking to the left. Around 7:30, Pomni is looking at Zooble and her mouth is open. But in the next scene, she's looking down and her mouth is closed. During the scene where Pomni explains about abandoning the idea of leaving, Zooble randomly changes positions and angles. From 8:35 to 8:38, Jax's eyes are different for 3 scenes. After Zooble tells Jax he's one of them, his eyes change in the scene where he looks at his hand. After Jax gets back on the couch and claims that the others are worried about him, he's smiling. But in the next scene, he's not. After Caine asks if they were in charge, Pomni and Zooble look at each other. But in the next shot, they are just standing still, looking at Caine. When the musical number ends, pieces of the characters are blown back by the explosion. But in the scene after Caine turns around, they're in different places. After Jax states he hasn't been in the cafe in a while, he's looking at his cup, but in the next scene, he looks at Pomni. When Pomni states that they should indulge with Caine a little, Ragatha looks at her with a fully open eye, but in the next scene, her eye is half-closed. Caine's bow tie is missing during the "Several Days Later…" scene. Near the end of Caine’s musical number, his hand is seen passing through some of the mannequin NPCs when going down the stairs. The scene where Kinger comes back after being shredded and the scene where Pomni looks at everyone, she randomly changes positions. Zooble in the cafe area is sitting at the end of the counter, but disappears in the scene where we see the sandwich on the floor with the camera panning up to Gangle. When Jax states that things were better before Pomni and Zooble arrived his eyes are ???, but in the next scene, they change. The cafe has 6 stools by the counter, but in the scene where everyone waits for Kinger, 2 of the stools by the counter are missing. When Pomni remembers where to find a computer, her head is normal, but in the next scene as she gets off the stool. her head is down. When Pomni leaves after telling the others to distract Caine and not remove the bucket on Kinger, Zooble turns their head for a bit, but in the next scene their head is more turned. The scene where Caine is telling Bubble to be a bit more gusto, he's in front of the curtain. But in the following scenes, he's turned toward the curtain. When Caine cuts off Ragatha and turns her, Gangle and Zooble into bowling pins, his eyes are briefly flipped. When Caine thinks he's not getting any spark of ideas, The Circus Members randomly change places. the same happens after Caine realizes something's up with them. This also happens after Pomni says to Caine that his ideas suck, and claims they plan to say bad things about them behind his back. When Ragatha panics after Caine is realizing that something is wrong, Jax, Gangle and Pomni are missing. When Pomni states that Caine is a terrible host, her lower eyelids are near half way. But they change in the scene where she states all he cares about is stroking his own ego rather than give them anything they really want. At 28:13, after Caine starts to break down, Ragatha, Gangle, Zooble and Jax are in different positions.
